title: Strange Silence
shot: medium from inside, then a slow push as he steps out from cover
camera: locked on the empty mouth, then a slow drift right to find KAIRO behind a rock
action: The entrance is empty, sunlight lying across the floor. KAIRO slowly comes out from behind a rock and looks outside, listening.
lighting: sun wedge on the floor, cool ambient bounce on the walls
audio: silence with a faint high ring; his breath is the loudest thing
dialogue_fa: چند لحظه همون‌جا موندم. نه صدایی... نه حرکتی... فقط یه سکوت عجیب. انگار غار نفسشو حبس کرده بود.
gloss_en: I stayed right there for a few moments. No sound... no movement... just a strange silence. As if the cave was holding its breath.
transition: silence is broken by a sound from behind him, motivating S16
image_prompt: Inside the cave mouth, the entrance empty and glowing with golden daylight, a hard wedge of sun on the rocky floor. KAIRO the stickman in a hide tunic peers out from behind a large rock at frame-left, only half of him visible, spear lowered. Dust suspended in the light. 2D cinematic animation, quiet composition, negative space.
video_prompt: Locked on the empty bright entrance, dust floating. The camera drifts slowly right and finds KAIRO easing out from behind a rock, one cautious step, head tilting to listen. He exhales. Nothing outside moves.
